acceptanceCriteria: A measured plan can carry test slices for a package so that no single package sets the shard floor, and the plan digest still covers the whole listed universe exactly once.
A recorded local wall-clock comparison of measured against universe placement on this repository decides promotion against the 20% bar; until then measured placement stays experimental.
body: Residual from V1-1579 (PR beamfall/corvint#1027, head b2ed935f0, 2026-10-17). Measured placement (STR-V0-050..054) partitions whole packages and does not apply AFP-V0-041 test slices, so internal/tasks/store alone sets the floor (live plan: 339 packages, 8 shards, shards 1-7 about 824s, shard 0 = internal/tasks/store alone at 896s). Promotion of measured placement also still needs the local 20% wall-clock bar against universe placement that balanced placement has; no wall-clock comparison was run.
title: corvint test shards: measured placement should carry AFP-V0-041 test slices and meet the promotion wall-clock bar (V1-1579 follow-up)
